text:
support-ops: FYI customer ACME is seeing p99 jumps on /v1/generate -- started ~08:14 UTC, p95 up 2x and p99 up 6x. @sre-oncall can you triage?

sre-oncall: looking. Any recent deploys? What region/tenant?

support-ops: Hosted us-east1, tenant acme-prod. No deploys logged in last 30m. Error rates are normal, just latency.

ajay: pulling metrics now. I see a pattern: traffic is extremely sparse but bursts of tiny requests (~20 tokens) every few seconds. Batch size target 8 but hold window is 120ms so we're waiting for batch fill -> long tail.

maria: that matches customer repro — many tiny prompts from their mobile clients. p50 fine, p95 up ~200ms, p99 up ~1.8s.

jen: can we temporarily lower the continuous-batcher hold_ms for that pool or route ACL for acme-prod to a faster path?

ajay: yes. Quick mitigation options: 1) set hold_ms=20 for pool us-east1-acme 2) force route acme-prod -> dedicated small-queue (if available) 3) enable prefix caching if repeated prefixes.

sre-oncall: prefer 1) quick change then monitor. Maria can you confirm the pool name?

maria: pool is rwd-us-east1-ml-7. I'll do a config change canary on 2 nodes.

support-ops: customer asked for repro steps — shared: 200 tiny requests in rapid succession from a single session. They sent a HAR.

ajay: repro looks solid. To reproduce locally: 
```
for i in `seq 1 200`; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi","max_tokens":20}'; sleep 0.03; done
```

jen: maria, what exact command are you running for the canary?

maria: patching via console: edit pool rwd-us-east1-ml-7 -> continuous_batcher.hold_ms from 120 -> 20, canary nodes: node-17,node-18. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: Started rolling config update on pool rwd-us-east1-ml-7 (canary nodes node-17,node-18).

ajay: initial telemetry looks promising: canary p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 240ms.

sre-oncall: if canary holds for 10m, roll to remaining fleet. Also open PR to add tenant-specific policy to auto-shrink hold_ms for tiny-request signals.

maria: will roll in 8m. Noting risk: reducing hold_ms increases unbatched GPU token cost. We should inform billing ops if rolled globally.

support-ops: pinged customer with temporary mitigation (reduced hold_ms) and asked for validation. They replied: saw immediate improvement in first 2m :thumbsup:.

jen: follow-up: add alert for "sparse-burst tail" where QPS low but p99 >> p95. Also add a runbook entry with these quick commands.

ajay: logging repro artifacts to ticket #INC-2148 and attaching HAR + metric snapshots.

sre-oncall: ticket created. action items: (1) complete fleet roll if canary stable (2) implement auto-shrink heuristic (3) evaluate cost delta and update billing if needed.

maria: fleet roll finished at 6554322040. p99 across pool stabilized to ~220-280ms.

support-ops: customer confirmed fix and closed escalation. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
